scripts.clean:vite-cache: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const p of ['node_modules/.vite','node_modules/.vite-temp']) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true}); console.log('Cleared Vite cache directories.');"
scripts.types:contracts:check: npm run types:contracts && git diff --exit-code -- src/generated/wasm-contracts
scripts.build: npm run wasm:build && npm run build:site
scripts.build:site: npm run sync:examples && npm run docs:refresh && vite build
scripts.test:unit: npm run sync:examples && vitest run src/tests
scripts.test:gpu: npm run sync:examples && npm run wasm:build && playwright test --config playwright.gpu.config.mjs
scripts.test:canaries: cargo test -p fresco-cli --test canaries && npm run sync:examples && npm run wasm:build && playwright test --config playwright.canaries.config.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run sync:examples && npm run wasm:build && vitest run src/tests/bootstrap-watchdog.integration.test.js src/tests/compile_warnings.integration.test.js src/tests/completion-provider.integration.test.js src/tests/visualizer_metadata.integration.test.js
